answer: Island-quorum admission resists sybils. The network splits into isolated islands, each running its own admission auction. An identity earns voting rights only in its home island by staking an onyx bond and doing timed work members verify. An attacker must win admission in many islands, buying a full bond and passing fresh verification each time; no bulk discount exists, so cost grows with N. Comet agents hopping islands lose all standing and re-earn every island's trust from zero. Honest members stake one bond at home and pay nothing more.
